# 1. Configuration & Setup

```{r init}
# ==============================================================================
# 1.1 GLOBAL DIRECTORY & PIPELINE CONFIGURATION
# ==============================================================================

# [EXPERIMENT ID] Toggle between "E1" and "E2". 
experiment_id <- "E1" 

# [PROJECT ROOT] Parent directory containing all component-specific subdirectories.
root_dir <- "C:/Code/UG_ERP_Project/results/EEG" 

# ==============================================================================
# 1.2 DEPENDENCY MANAGEMENT
# ==============================================================================
if(!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, stringr, fs, gridExtra, scales, here)

# eegUtils is mandatory for topographic interpolation and mapping.
if (!require("eegUtils")) {
  stop("Critical Package Missing: 'eegUtils'. Install via devtools::install_github('craddm/eegUtils')")
}

# ==============================================================================
# 1.3 COMPONENT & SPATIOTEMPORAL DEFINITIONS
# ==============================================================================
# Extensible dictionary for Response-Locked components
component_specs <- list(
  
  CPP = list(
    win_ms = c(-300, 50),            # Relative to response execution (0 ms)
    roi = c("Pz", "Cz", "C1", "C2", "CP1", "CP2"),
    source_comp = "CPP"
  )
  
  # Future-proofing: Add components like LRP (Lateralized Readiness Potential) here
  # LRP = list(...)
)

# Experimental condition nomenclature mapping
emotion_list <- c("aff", "dis", "dom", "enj")
offer_types  <- c("fair", "unfair")

cat(sprintf("Pipeline Initialized.\nTarget Experiment: %s\nData Root: %s\n", experiment_id, root_dir))

```

# 2. Methodological Helper Functions

```{r helpers}
# ==============================================================================
# Dynamic Scale Limit Computation
# ==============================================================================
compute_limits <- function(values, symmetric = TRUE) {
  if (all(is.na(values))) return(c(-1, 1))
  
  if (symmetric) {
    max_val <- max(abs(values), na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.infinite(max_val) || max_val == 0) return(c(-1, 1))
    # Round up to the nearest 0.5 step for clean legends
    max_val <- ceiling(max_val * 2) / 2 
    return(c(-max_val, max_val))
  } else {
    return(range(values, na.rm = TRUE))
  }
}

# ==============================================================================
# Unified Topographic Plotting Engine
# ==============================================================================
plot_topo_unified <- function(dat_long, chan_locs, roi, 
                              main_title, sub_title, caption_text, 
                              filename, limits, show_contour = TRUE) {
  
  if(!"electrode" %in% names(dat_long)) {
    warning("Spatial mapping failed: 'electrode' identifier missing.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Apply automatic text wrapping for safe rendering
  safe_title <- str_wrap(main_title, width = 45)
  safe_sub   <- str_wrap(sub_title, width = 45)

  p <- topoplot(
    dat_long, chan_locs = chan_locs, interp_limit = "head",
    contour = show_contour, points = TRUE, highlights = roi,
    palette = "RdBu", limits = limits
  ) +
    labs(title = safe_title, subtitle = safe_sub, caption = caption_text) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", margin = margin(b=8)),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(b=5)),
          plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40", margin = margin(t=10)),
          plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15))
  
  ggsave(filename, plot = p, device = "png", width = 6.5, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)
  
  return(p)
}

```

# 3. Component Processing & Visualization Engine

```{r main_pipeline}
for (comp_name in names(component_specs)) {
  
  spec <- component_specs[[comp_name]]
  
  target_source <- ifelse(!is.null(spec$source_comp), spec$source_comp, comp_name)
  target_folder_name <- paste0("Results_", target_source, "_", experiment_id)
  comp_results_dir   <- file.path(root_dir, target_folder_name)
  
  cat(paste0("\n", str_dup("#", 75), "\n"))
  cat(sprintf("ANALYSIS TARGET: %s | PHYSICAL SOURCE: %s\n", comp_name, target_folder_name))
  cat(paste0(str_dup("#", 75), "\n"))
  
  if (!dir_exists(comp_results_dir)) {
    cat(sprintf("Directory unresolved: %s. \nEnsure upstream extraction is complete. Skipping.\n", comp_results_dir))
    next
  }
  
  sessions <- dir_ls(comp_results_dir, glob = "*Session_*", type = "directory")
  if (length(sessions) == 0) { cat("Session index empty. Skipping.\n"); next }
  current_session <- sort(sessions, decreasing = TRUE)[1]
  cat(sprintf("Active Session Target: %s\n", basename(current_session)))
  
  chan_file <- file.path(current_session, "Regression_Results", "channel_locations.csv")
  data_file <- file.path(current_session, "Regression_Results", "topomap_data_for_R", paste0(target_source, "_topomap_data.csv"))
  
  if (!file.exists(chan_file) || !file.exists(data_file)) { 
    cat("Spatial montage or topographic matrix missing. Skipping.\n"); next 
  }
  
  chanlocs <- read_csv(chan_file, show_col_types = FALSE, lazy = FALSE) %>% rename(electrode = channel)
  topo_data <- read_csv(data_file, show_col_types = FALSE, lazy = FALSE)
  
  # ==========================================================================
  # 3.1 FACTORIAL DIFFERENCE COMPUTATION
  # ==========================================================================
  cat("    Computing factorial contrasts (Regression-Corrected)...\n")
  
  for(o in offer_types) {
    neu_col <- paste0("raw_neu_", o)
    for(e in emotion_list) {
      tgt <- paste0("raw_", e, "_", o)
      if(neu_col %in% names(topo_data) & tgt %in% names(topo_data)) 
        topo_data[[paste0("conditional_diff_", e, "_vs_neu_", o)]] <- topo_data[[tgt]] - topo_data[[neu_col]]
    }
    
    cols <- paste0("raw_", c("neu", emotion_list), "_", o)
    valid <- cols[cols %in% names(topo_data)]
    if(length(valid)>0) topo_data[[paste0("offer_main_", o)]] <- rowMeans(topo_data[, valid], na.rm=TRUE)
  }
  
  for(e in c("neu", emotion_list)) {
    cols <- paste0("raw_", e, "_", offer_types)
    valid <- cols[cols %in% names(topo_data)]
    if(length(valid)>0) topo_data[[paste0("emotion_main_", e)]] <- rowMeans(topo_data[, valid], na.rm=TRUE)
    
    if(e != "neu" && paste0("emotion_main_", e) %in% names(topo_data) && "emotion_main_neu" %in% names(topo_data)) {
       topo_data[[paste0("emotion_diff_main_", e, "_vs_neu")]] <- topo_data[[paste0("emotion_main_", e)]] - topo_data[["emotion_main_neu"]]
    }
  }
  
  if("offer_main_unfair" %in% names(topo_data) && "offer_main_fair" %in% names(topo_data)) {
    topo_data[["offer_diff_main_unfair_vs_fair"]] <- topo_data[["offer_main_unfair"]] - topo_data[["offer_main_fair"]]
  }

  for(e in c("neu", emotion_list)) {
    unfair_col <- paste0("raw_", e, "_unfair")
    fair_col   <- paste0("raw_", e, "_fair")
    if(unfair_col %in% names(topo_data) && fair_col %in% names(topo_data)) {
      topo_data[[paste0("offer_diff_conditional_", e, "_unfair_vs_fair")]] <- topo_data[[unfair_col]] - topo_data[[fair_col]]
    }
  }

  # ==========================================================================
  # 3.2 GLOBAL SCALING & DIRECTORY PROVISIONING
  # ==========================================================================
  out_base <- file.path(current_session, "Regression_Results", paste0("topoplots_R_", comp_name))
  dir_map_static <- c("raw", "diff", "emotion_main", "emotion_diff", "offer_main", "offer_diff", "offer_diff_conditional")
  walk(file.path(out_base, dir_map_static), dir_create)
  
  topo_long <- topo_data %>% rename(electrode = channel)
  
  cat("    Deriving dynamic global scaling properties...\n")
  
  raw_cols <- grep("^raw_|^offer_main_|^emotion_main_", names(topo_long), value = TRUE)
  raw_vals <- if(length(raw_cols) > 0) unlist(topo_long[, raw_cols]) else 0
  diff_cols <- grep("diff_", names(topo_long), value = TRUE)
  diff_vals <- if(length(diff_cols) > 0) unlist(topo_long[, diff_cols]) else 0
  
  lims_raw  <- compute_limits(raw_vals)
  lims_diff <- compute_limits(diff_vals)
  
  cat(sprintf("       -> Amplitude bounds secured at: [%.1f, %.1f] µV\n", lims_raw[1], lims_raw[2]))
  cat(sprintf("       -> Contrast bounds secured at: [%.1f, %.1f] µV\n", lims_diff[1], lims_diff[2]))

  # ==========================================================================
  # 3.3 STATIC TOPOGRAPHIC RENDERINGS
  # ==========================================================================
  title_prefix <- "Regression-Corrected"
  time_cap <- paste0("Response-Locked Window: ", spec$win_ms[1], " to ", spec$win_ms[2], " ms")

  # [A] Raw Conditions
  for (ofr in offer_types) {
    for (emo in c("neu", emotion_list)) {
      col <- paste0("raw_", emo, "_", ofr)
      if (col %in% names(topo_long)) {
        plot_topo_unified(
          dat_long = select(topo_long, electrode, amplitude = all_of(col)), chan_locs = chanlocs, roi = spec$roi,
          main_title = paste(comp_name, title_prefix), sub_title = paste(str_to_title(ofr), str_to_title(emo), sep=" | "),
          caption_text = time_cap,
          filename = file.path(out_base, "raw", paste0(comp_name, "_", ofr, "_", emo, ".png")), limits = lims_raw
        )
      }
    }
  }
  
  # [B] Conditional Differences (Emotion vs Neu within Offer)
  for (ofr in offer_types) {
    for (emo in emotion_list) {
      col <- paste0("conditional_diff_", emo, "_vs_neu_", ofr)
      if (col %in% names(topo_long)) {
        plot_topo_unified(
          dat_long = select(topo_long, electrode, amplitude = all_of(col)), chan_locs = chanlocs, roi = spec$roi,
          main_title = paste(comp_name, title_prefix), sub_title = paste(str_to_title(ofr), paste0(str_to_title(emo), "-Neu"), sep=" | "),
          caption_text = "Difference Waveform Morphology",
          filename = file.path(out_base, "diff", paste0(comp_name, "_diff_", ofr, "_", emo, "_vs_neu.png")),
          limits = lims_diff, show_contour = FALSE
        )
      }
    }
  }
  
  # [C] Main Effect of Offer (Unfair vs Fair)
  if ("offer_diff_main_unfair_vs_fair" %in% names(topo_long)) {
     plot_topo_unified(
        dat_long = select(topo_long, electrode, amplitude = offer_diff_main_unfair_vs_fair), chan_locs = chanlocs, roi = spec$roi,
        main_title = paste(comp_name, title_prefix), sub_title = "Main Contrast: Unfair minus Fair", caption_text = "Main Effect Visualization",
        filename = file.path(out_base, "offer_diff", paste0(comp_name, "_diff_unfair_vs_fair.png")),
        limits = lims_diff, show_contour = FALSE
     )
  }

  # [D] Main Effect of Emotion
  for (e in c("neu", emotion_list)) {
    col <- paste0("emotion_main_", e)
    if (col %in% names(topo_long)) {
       plot_topo_unified(
        dat_long = select(topo_long, electrode, amplitude = all_of(col)), chan_locs = chanlocs, roi = spec$roi,
        main_title = paste(comp_name, title_prefix), sub_title = paste0("Main Effect Context: ", str_to_title(e)),
        caption_text = time_cap,
        filename = file.path(out_base, "emotion_main", paste0(comp_name, "_main_emotion_", e, ".png")), limits = lims_raw
      )
    }
  }

  # [E] Main Contrast of Emotion (vs Neu)
  for (e in emotion_list) {
    col <- paste0("emotion_diff_main_", e, "_vs_neu")
    if (col %in% names(topo_long)) {
       plot_topo_unified(
        dat_long = select(topo_long, electrode, amplitude = all_of(col)), chan_locs = chanlocs, roi = spec$roi,
        main_title = paste(comp_name, title_prefix), sub_title = paste0("Main Contrast: ", str_to_title(e), " minus Neu"), caption_text = "Main Effect Visualization",
        filename = file.path(out_base, "emotion_diff", paste0(comp_name, "_main_diff_", e, "_vs_neu.png")),
        limits = lims_diff, show_contour = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
  
  # [F] Conditional Offer Contrast (Unfair - Fair within Emotion)
  for (e in c("neu", emotion_list)) {
    col <- paste0("offer_diff_conditional_", e, "_unfair_vs_fair")
    if (col %in% names(topo_long)) {
       plot_topo_unified(
        dat_long = select(topo_long, electrode, amplitude = all_of(col)), chan_locs = chanlocs, roi = spec$roi,
        main_title = paste(comp_name, title_prefix), sub_title = paste0("Unfair - Fair | Structural Context: ", str_to_title(e)), caption_text = "Conditional Analysis",
        filename = file.path(out_base, "offer_diff_conditional", paste0(comp_name, "_diff_unfair_vs_fair_in_", e, ".png")),
        limits = lims_diff, show_contour = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
  
  cat(sprintf("    Exportation complete. Assets localized at: %s\n", out_base))
}

# Free system resources
graphics.off()
closeAllConnections()
gc(verbose = FALSE)

```
